answer: An identity locks 70 credits, claims a river plot in the public atlas, self-prices it, and pays a 5% Harberger tax per epoch into the haven fund. Anyone may buy at the listed price, so underpricing loses the plot and overpricing bleeds tax. First tax 40, the k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail: each entry carries its owner's key. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its plot.
